meditations.title: Slow body scan
meditations.description: Attention sinks from your feet to your scalp, leaving each part heavy and warm behind it.

meditations.title: Breath focus
meditations.description: Settle onto the breath — its weight, the still pause before the next one — and let it slow on its own.

meditations.title: Forest path
meditations.description: A windless forest clearing at dusk, held still while the light fades and the quiet settles like silt.

meditations.title: Down the staircase
meditations.description: A wide, soft staircase into the warm dark, one slow step down with every breath, until there is nowhere lower to go.

meditations.title: Tense and release
meditations.description: Each muscle pulls gently tight for a breath, then lets go all at once, until the body forgets how to hold on.

meditations.title: The lake at dusk
meditations.description: A mirror-still lake as the last light leaves it, the mist settling, the water holding everything quiet.

meditations.title: The warm room
meditations.description: A low fire, a heavy blanket, the dark soft against the windows — and you, the last one awake, with nothing left to tend.

meditations.title: The long exhale
meditations.description: The out-breath stretches longer than the in, again and again, until letting go is the only thing left to do.

meditations.title: The quiet shuffle
meditations.description: A slow drift of small, unrelated images with no thread to follow — the mind, given nothing to solve, finally lets go.

meditations.title: Under a slow sky
meditations.description: Lying back beneath a vast, turning night sky, the ground letting go, the body growing weightless among the stars.
